blocks.text: A lot of stress comes on the people. No matter how oppressed and depressed you are, Jesus is the One that will lift you up. What we need is a tranquil message, like cool water; a message that will bless His people. The Lord is a great provider and a great revealer. Through symbols in nature, He assures us that He cares for each one of us.

As the word, He is our teacher, our deliverer and our future. He is our miracle worker, our knowledge, our wisdom, our substance and our treasure. He is our positive essence. By His Spirit, He is our confidence and wellbeing.

As our Angel, He quickens us. He is the guardian of His people. As the lamb, He takes our sins away. As the Eagle, He is our Prophet. He reveals secrets. We sit in heavenly places with Him (Ephesians 2:6) He carries us on His wings (Psalm 91:4). He is our safe passage through the earth.
As the White Dove, He is our peace and tranquility. He is our great lover. Satan is a great hater of God’s church.
As the Lion, He is our defender, our shield. He will destroy the enemies of the gospel at Armageddon. You can depend on Him.

As the Rock, He is the shadow that covers us from the heat. He is our strength and our steadfastness. He is our fortress, the honey in the Rock. He is unmovable. You will never move those rocks unless He moves them.

As the Lily of the Valley and the Rose of Sharon, He is our essence. He is our spiritual flower. His presence is wonderful. The Lord is speaking to us in symbols to show His love and peace. He is wooing us in symbols.
As the Sun, He is our righteousness, the anointing and power. He is the Sun of Righteousness with healing in His wings (Malachi 4:2). He is the endurance that we have.
As creator, He is our caretaker. He understands us completely when no one else can. He stands to help us. This should help you.
As the Moon, reflecting the Almightiness of the Lord, He is our light that goes into eternity with us. There is power in this message to lift you up in this time that we are.
As our Sword, He is the word of God in action. It is not a dull sword. He is the defeater of Satan and the world.
As the Cloud, He is our refreshing, the glory of spiritual rain.
As the Father, He is the overseer, as the Son, He is our Redeemer, and as the Holy Spirit, He is our guide. He is a great revelator. He is our leader. He brings revival.
As the Lightening, He cuts a path for us. He is our authority. He makes a way when no one else can

As the Wind, He stirs and cleanses us. He is the Comforter. He alerts us. His voice speaking to our hearts stirs us up. The disciples had a visitation of the “rushing mighty wind” at Pentecost (Acts 2:2).

As the Fire, He is a refiner and purifier of our faith and character (Malachi 3:2). He gives us a fiery power of faith. When what was inside Jesus Christ glowed on the outside during the transfiguration, the disciples were afraid to look at Him. At the translation, what is inside you will come out and you will be gone. A fiery type of faith is going to change us for the translation. It is the devil that makes you feel down. He will help you out of the storm and troubles of this life, when it looks as if there is no way. He will solve the problems. His love and faith will do it. He will lift you up as the eagle if you trust in Him. There is no problem that the Lord cannot solve. Testimony: A woman received a prayer cloth in the mail. Her little girl had pain in her ear. The child was in great pain. The woman put the prayer cloth in the little girl’s ear. In a moment of time, the little girl was playing and laughing. She had no more pain. That is the fiery presence of God on those prayer cloths to work miracles. Paul used cloths to minister to the sick (Acts 19: 12). When you think God is not there and you are oppressed, that’s the devil. The Lord said, “I am right inside you or you are dead!” He said, “Where is your faith?” It is the devil that drags you down.

As the Water, he quenches our spiritual thirst. As we get closer to the translation, the more water He will give us. Mankind is thirsty but they will not turn to Jesus. He will satisfy you, give you rest, salvation and eternal life. He is the Voice of the Archangel.

As the Wheel, “…O wheel” (Ezekiel 10: 13), He is our great Cherub. He is the trump of God. He will change us and take us away—Come up, hither. He will raise the dead. All that He has told us in the word of God will change us. If we believe it, it becomes the fire that changes and translates us. There are many symbols in the bible showing us His love and how He cares for us.

As Jesus (this is all about Him), He is our friend and companion. He is our father, mother, brother, sister and all. If forsaken by all, He is whatever forsook you. He will again eat with the elect. Abraham prepared food for the Lord and He ate (Genesis 18: 8). He was His (the Lord’s) friend. Two angels went to Sodom, Lot prepared food for them and they ate (Genesis 19:3). People overlook the fact that the two angels ate with Lot. Be careful, you entertain angel unawares (Hebrews 13: 2). At the end of the age, we will eat with the Lord at the Marriage Supper. Jesus appeared to Abraham in theophany as a man. “Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad” (John 8: 56). It was Jesus in theophany in the flesh. If you say that is not true, you are a liar.

“He shall cover you with his feathers and underneath his wings shalt thou trust” (Psalm 91: 4). In this message, He is covering you with His feathers. Through this message, He is showing you that He is your rock and your fortress. Jesus said as it was in the days of the flood and Sodom so it shall be in the last days. Abraham and Lot entertained angels unawares. The same thing can happen today; you can entertain angels unawares. Before the end of the age, angels will appear in theophany; an angel may knock on your door or you may run into an angel on the street. Jesus said the same thing will happen. There may be angels here listening to this message. Paul wrote that you should be careful, you may entertain angels unawares. They can appear in the form of a man—and there are angels that will appear in glory light. But, they can change as a man. He has different angels doing different things.

There are many names of the Lord in the bible. These are just a few of them (Isaiah 9:6). He is the law- giver. He is the Lord Jehovah, the Everlasting Father. It doesn’t matter how He appears to me, if He has the word, I will accept Him. The Lord said, I don’t know any other God (Isaiah 44: 8). When you put Jesus in His place of deliverance, you are in a place where you can feel His comfort. He takes away the confusion. Denominations have got too many gods, their minds are confused. Don’t let S atan trick you off the power in the name of Jesus. The Lord Jesus will seal this message in your heart. It will give you confidence.

This world is confused. They need jokers (comedians) to make them laugh. There is no real happiness. In the US where they are rich and have a lot of wealth, people are supposed to be happy, they are not; neither are people happy in the foreign countries. In Christ is our wellbeing. He is our lover, our friend and companion. You listen to this message; He is your safe passage through this world. This is a negative world. In our spiritual world is life and peace.
